name: Langer et al. 2017 — Multimodal Resource for Studying Information Processing in the Developing Brain (MIPDB)
readme:
# MIPDB: a multimodal resource for studying information processing in the developing brain (EEG + eye tracking)
## Summary
This is the **Child Mind Institute (CMI) MIPDB** dataset — a multimodal resource for
studying information processing in the developing brain. High-density
electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking data were recorded from a developmental
cohort spanning childhood to adulthood while participants performed a battery of
cognitive and perceptual paradigms. The resource was designed to enable research on the
maturation of information-processing in the human brain.
The BIDS conversion in this NEMAR record contains EEG data for **111 participants**
(`sub-*` folders) under the `eeg/` modality.
## Modality and paradigms
- **Modalities:** High-density EEG (128-channel EGI HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net,
  recorded with NetStation at 500 Hz) and eye tracking
- **Population:** Developmental cohort (children, adolescents, and adults; ages ~6–44
  per Langer et al. 2017)
- **Paradigm battery (per Langer et al. 2017):** resting state, surround suppression,
  naturalistic viewing, contrast-change detection, sequence learning, and symbol search
> **Note on task labels:** In this conversion each recording block is published as
> `task-blockNN` (`task-block01` … `task-block10`) because the per-block paradigm mapping
> is not explicitly enumerated in Langer et al. 2017. The paradigm sequence above is
> identical across subjects per the paper, but the exact mapping from block index to
> paradigm should be confirmed against the CMI MIPDB documentation before analysis.
> Source eye-tracking and behavioural data are preserved under `sourcedata/`.
## Participants
This BIDS dataset includes **111 subjects** (anonymised CMI IDs, e.g. `sub-A00051826`).
See `participants.tsv` and the data paper for the developmental age range and
demographics.
## Original dataset / data paper
Please cite the original Scientific Data descriptor when using this dataset:
> Langer, N., Ho, E. J., Alexander, L. M., Xu, H. Y., Jozanovic, R. K., Henin, S.,
> Petroni, A., Cohen, S., Marcelle, E. T., Parra, L. C., Milham, M. P., & Kelly, S. P.
> (2017). *A resource for assessing information processing in the developing brain using
> EEG and eye tracking.* **Scientific Data, 4, 170040.**
> https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2017.40
- **DOI:** [10.1038/sdata.2017.40](https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2017.40)
- **Source / project:** Child Mind Institute — [CMI EEG / Eye-tracking resource](https://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/cmi_eeg/)
- **Source data:** `s3://fcp-indi/data/Projects/EEG_Eyetracking_CMI_data/`
## Attribution
This dataset was created by the Child Mind Institute and collaborators (Langer, Parra,
Milham, Kelly, and colleagues). Please credit the original creators and cite the data
paper above. This NEMAR record redistributes the dataset in BIDS format; EEG-BIDS /
MNE-BIDS and related BIDS tools were used only for standardisation, not as the source of
the data.
